verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to mask or redact inputs or outputs before Weave stores them in traces. Tracing docs say only that Weave automatically captures code, inputs, outputs and metadata. The only related item is a Guardrails PII-detection scorer, which classifies content after the fact and does not redact it before storage, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
